scope: All 44 VCF-only table environments indexed by the VCFv4.5 source inventory. Additional raw TeX table environments belong to BCF serialization and are excluded from this VCF-text queue.
method: All 44 VCFv4.5 table environments have author-context dispositions. The 21 reserved INFO rows and 63 reserved FORMAT rows have been extracted as separate descriptive field-definition candidates and linked to the atomic ledger. These candidates are not independent approvals; field-specific prose reconciliation, cross-version applicability and independent review remain open. Row terminator counts are navigation metadata, not semantic row or requirement counts. A supplemental author adjudication artifact now records a table-specific normative/informative disposition for all 44 tables and replaces repeated generic open questions with explicit locator-level context and version-delta work. These dispositions do not constitute independent review; all 44 tables retain open locator-level reconciliation and version comparison. Exact source-context line ranges and contextual findings are now recorded per table using the row-semantic, SV/breakend and pedigree/gVCF context reviews. This closes the author locator-capture subtask only; all 44 version-delta assessments and all independent reviews remain open. A preliminary section-level applicability comparison against VCFv4.1-4.4 is now recorded per table. It identifies presence/absence and relevant source locators, but does not establish exact table identity or complete clause-level semantic deltas. All 44 tables still require full clause-level version reconciliation.

tables.enclosing_section: Character encoding, non-printable characters and characters with special meaning
tables.preceding_context: Note that non-printable characters U+0000--U+0008, U+000B--U+000C, U+000E--U+001F are disallowed. Line separators must be CR+LF or LF and they are allowed only as line separators at end of line. Some characters have a special meaning when they appear (such as field delimiters `\verb|;|' in INFO or `\verb|:|' FORMAT fields), and for any other meaning they must be represented with the capitalized percent encoding:  \begingroup\footnotesize
